data.limitation: Yahoo adjusted prices restated ex post; close bars not executable quotes
Current-vintage FRED-derived Treasury slope, not strictly PIT
CPI used as common ex-post deflator only

signal_timing: At previous month's last ETF trading CLOSE compute 6-calendar-month SPY adjusted-price momentum. Last Treasury spread observation dated <= that trading date minus FIVE calendar days. Entry on first ETF trading day CLOSE of new month. Exit/next entry on first ETF trading day CLOSE of next month.

signals.equity_downtrend: SPY six-calendar-month price ratio < 1; nearest close on or before calendar cutoff

arms.combined: 60 SPY + 40 GLD when inverted AND equity_downtrend; otherwise 60 SPY + 40 TLT
arms.macro_only: 60 SPY + 40 GLD when inverted; else 60 SPY + 40 TLT
arms.trend_only: 60 SPY + 40 GLD when equity_downtrend; else 60 SPY + 40 TLT

treatment: At each entry close rebalance previous drifted holdings to target weights. Cost 10bp per dollar transacted, including initial notional. Monthly holding return is weighted adjusted-close price ratio between consecutive first-trading-day closes; no same-session future signal. CPI: index of entry month vs exit month, ratio nominal/(CPI_exit/CPI_entry).
caveats: SPY dividends in adjusted prices, no dividend double count
No independent OOS due to LLM data exposure
test_plan: Check signals strictly earlier than entries
Identical monthly dates across all arms
One initial cost and rebalance costs exactly once
Compare full portfolio wealth, no independent seed
stop: One run and mechanical checks only. No optimization or re-selection after examining results. Record negative or UNKNOWN; no capital use.
